schema: CREATE TABLE "Booths" ("booth_num" INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, "is_open" INTEGER);
correct_query: SELECT DISTINCT b1.booth_num FROM Booths AS b1 JOIN Booths AS b2 ON ABS(b1.booth_num - b2.booth_num) = 1 AND b1.is_open = 1 AND b2.is_open = 1 ORDER BY b1.booth_num

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Uses SUM(is_open) OVER (ORDER BY booth_num) - booth_num as a gap-and-island grouping key, which collides for non-adjacent booths when an intermediate booth has is_open = 2
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH BoothGaps AS (SELECT booth_num, is_open, SUM(is_open) OVER (ORDER BY booth_num) - booth_num AS grp_gap FROM Booths) SELECT booth_num FROM BoothGaps WHERE grp_gap IN (SELECT grp_gap FROM BoothGaps WHERE is_open = 1 GROUP BY grp_gap HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND is_open = 1 ORDER BY booth_num

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Uses booth_num - SUM(is_open) OVER (ORDER BY booth_num) as a gap-and-island grouping key, which collides for non-adjacent booths when an intermediate booth has is_open = 2
expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.query: WITH BoothGaps AS (SELECT booth_num, is_open, booth_num - SUM(is_open) OVER (ORDER BY booth_num) AS grp_gap FROM Booths) SELECT booth_num FROM BoothGaps WHERE grp_gap IN (SELECT grp_gap FROM BoothGaps WHERE is_open = 1 GROUP BY grp_gap HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AND is_open = 1 ORDER BY booth_num
